name: BNBX helper pulls any approver's BNBX for any caller
summary: An unverified helper 0x389a9ae2, which BNBX holders had approved, exposed a path that calls transferFrom on arbitrary approving holders without authenticating the caller. The attacker pulled about 858k BNBX from some 180 holders through it and sold it into the BNBX/BNB pair.
notes: BNBX has no market price, so the holders' pulled BNBX is valued at what its sale in the anchor realised (rule 12): the 79.24 BNB the BNBX/BNB pair paid out.
